ideas.title: Deep PC cleanup
ideas.notes: Scan/preview first; safe cleanup; quarantine/reversible where practical; protect projects/user data; no blind registry cleaner.

ideas.title: Operator security / antivirus control center
ideas.notes: Integrate Windows Defender first: status, scans, threat history, quarantine, signatures, firewall, persistence inventory.

ideas.title: Deep-Freeze-style healthy baseline / restore
ideas.notes: Start with last-known-good snapshots, restore points, manifests, integrity baseline and rollback. Do not start with a kernel disk filter.

ideas.title: Voice-driven INVENTHOR control
ideas.notes: Voice understanding stays in INVENTHOR; Operator receives structured capabilities/tasks.

ideas.title: Inventhor Operator logo and final visual identity
ideas.notes: Current logo not accepted. Defer branding and final desktop visual polish until unattended runtime is verified.

ideas.title: Full PC control center
ideas.notes: Performance, cleanup, processes, services, storage, network, startup, software updates, desktop control and power/system.

ideas.title: Hosted INVENTHOR App Factory client portal
ideas.notes: Future non-executable product vision: publish one simple, stable INVENTHOR customer Android portal via Google Play (account/login, request/specification chat, quote and scope confirmation, compliant payment, order tracking, acceptance and artifact delivery). Production stays in the owner's centralized Brain -> Organizer -> Operator -> Design Studio -> independent QA Factory; customer never receives the owner's private Brain, keys, personal project ledger, or full engine. Different customer projects/tenants must be fully isolated. Payment is before costly production AFTER a clear quote, verified on a trusted backend (not solely a mobile payment-success screen); refunds/disputes, cancellation, licensing, delivery and support need documented policy. For in-app digital services, assess Google Play billing policy; Play Billing often required unless a permitted exception or eligible region-specific alternative billing program. Do not promise a simple external checkout for Play-distributed app before classification. Future option: one-time custom project fee, then maintenance/subscription. No launch now, no pricing authorization or queued Operator task; resume primary QA Factory live integration and Brain native continuity. Hosted customer app and separately sold self-hosted/portable edition are distinct future product modes.
